form_analysis.feedback: Well-tailored aftercare for an acne-focused BHA peel. Excellently addresses the unique aspects: oil reduction, purging likelihood, and the importance of not over-drying the skin. Good guidance on managing the temporary dryness and tightness.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare advice is for a salicylic acid peel, a beta-hydroxy acid (BHA) that penetrates oil to exfoliate inside pores. It is highly effective for acne-prone, oily, and congested skin. Proper aftercare manages dryness and supports clearing.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow the General Chemical Peel Principles. The notes below are specific to salicylic acid peels.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: You may feel a slight tingling or warming sensation. A 'frost' (white precipitate) is common with salicylic acid and will fade within hours. Skin will be pink and may feel tight or dry for 24-72 hours. Mild peeling, often described as 'mice noses' or fine flaking around pores, may occur 2-4 days post-peel.

sections.title: Specific Instructions for Acne-Prone Skin
items: Purging: It is COMMON to experience a increase in breakouts (purging) 3-7 days post-peel as underlying congestion is accelerated to the surface. Do not pick. This is temporary.

Oil Control: Your oil production may temporarily increase as the skin compensates for dryness, or it may decrease. Use a light, oil-free, non-comedogenic moisturizer to balance the skin without clogging pores.
Avoid Over-Drying: Do not use other drying agents (benzoyl peroxide, strong acne washes) for 5-7 days post-peel. Let the peel do its work.
Sun Protection: While BHA is less photosensitising than AHA, sun protection is still essential for healing skin. Use an oil-free SPF.

sections.title: Cleansing
sections.content: Cleanse gently with a lukewarm water and a mild, sulfate-free cleanser. Avoid harsh scrubs or brushes.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
sections.content: Avoid sweating and heat (exercise, saunas) for 48 hours to prevent irritation and stinging.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: Avoid makeup for 24 hours if possible. When you resume, use non-comedogenic products and clean application tools to avoid introducing bacteria.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: If you experience severe erythema (redness), swelling, or crusting, contact your practitioner.
Results include fewer blackheads/whiteheads, reduced oiliness, and clearer skin. Salicylic acid also has anti-inflammatory properties.
A series of peels (every 2-4 weeks) is most effective for treating active acne and congestion.
This peel is suitable for sensitive and darker skin tones when used appropriately, due to its anti-inflammatory nature.

recommendations: Emphasize that the 'frost' is not bleaching or scarring, just a characteristic of the acid crystallizing.
